Quality market

Verified.
No shortcuts.

A separate, stricter market. A seller only gets a Quality listing after clearing checks — the higher price has to be explained by something real: materials, warranty, inspection, or verified specification.

  • ✓ Verified specification on every listing.
  • ✓ Inspection or warranty evidence required before approval.
  • ✓ Zero tolerance — one upheld complaint can suspend a listing pending review.

AiSMUS

OUR STORY

Why this marketplace exists

AiSMUS is being built as a practical place where products, services, skills and opportunities can meet customers in one connected marketplace.

Our story

The idea is to connect everyday buying and service needs with digital sales and marketing, so a person can discover an item, find a service, contact the right provider, and keep track of what they have done on the platform.

The problem we are solving

People often have to jump between different sellers, service providers, social pages, websites and messaging apps. We are working toward one clearer path for discovery, ordering, service requests, partnerships and follow-up.

Our goals

Make products easier to discover. Make useful services easier to book. Help sellers and service providers reach customers. Connect social-media traffic to real marketplace activity. Give customers a simple record of their activity.

Our targets

Grow a trusted network of sellers, service providers, schools and partner organizations; expand product and service categories; improve ordering and delivery connections; and build a marketplace that can serve people across locations.

What we want to become

A connected sales, marketing and services universe where customers can discover, compare, order, book, communicate and return to their history without losing the thread of what they did.

Terms & Conditions & Rules

READ BEFORE SUBMITTING

Marketplace terms & rules

These rules are intended to keep listings clear, honest and safer for customers, sellers, service providers and renters.

1. Accurate information

Do not submit false prices, descriptions, ownership details, availability, specifications, photos or business information. You are responsible for the information you submit.

2. Right to list

Only list products, services or rentals you are authorized to offer. Do not list property, vehicles, equipment or other items that you do not have permission to rent or sell.

3. Prohibited activity

No illegal goods or services, fraud, impersonation, stolen property, misleading claims, harassment, or attempts to bypass platform checks or customer protections.

4. Quality & Affordable listings

Affordable listings are not presented as premium or automatically verified. Quality listings may require verification or supporting evidence. A listing can be reviewed, corrected, suspended or removed when rules are not met.

5. Rentals

Rental providers must clearly state the price period, deposit where applicable, availability, location and important rental conditions. Any agreement, inspection, handover and payment terms should be made clear to the customer before a booking is completed.

6. Customer conduct

Customers must provide truthful information, respect providers and use the platform for lawful purposes. Reviews should reflect genuine experiences and must not be fabricated or abusive.

7. Platform review

Submitting a form does not guarantee approval, publication or verification. The platform may request additional information and may restrict or remove listings that breach these rules or applicable law.

8. Acceptance

By checking the acceptance box on a submission form, you confirm that you have read and agree to follow these Terms & Conditions and Marketplace Rules.
